_doc:
IMPAIRMENT (Phase 065): an impaired resident is given a confidently wrong percept, and the truth goes only to the referee block. The percept is the Phase 062 perceiver's percept (world/perception.json); this table decides when and how it is made wrong.

SWITCH. IMPAIRMENT.enabled defaults to false. Off, the agent view is what it was before Phase 065. A game may override the switch, the strength and the sources with `game.impairment_scenario` (a dict with any of enabled, strength, sources). The percept needs PERCEPTION.enabled as well: with the perceiver off there is no percept to distort.

STRENGTH AND CAP. IMPAIRMENT.strength (0 to 1) scales every rate. The chance that one percept is distorted is 1 minus the product, over the active sources that apply, of (1 - strength x rate), capped at max_rate. Each rate is a step or a level of its DISTORTION row.

SOURCES. DISTORTION has one row per source. `measure` names the value the row reads (intoxication_band: the perceiver's band; fatigue: 1 minus the stamina reserve; illness: 1 when the resident is ill; light: the light the resident sees by). A row with `levels` maps a category to a rate. A row with `steps` maps a number to a rate: the last step whose threshold the measure reaches applies. `kinds` names the mechanisms the source may use, for each percept kind (person, thing). A mechanism is the way a percept goes wrong. lower_tier: the percept drops one tier (a person becomes 'a person'; a thing becomes 'something'). neighbour_stage: a person's life stage is replaced by a neighbouring stage (IMPAIRMENT_NEIGHBOURS). nearby_entity: the stage, job or kind is taken from another resident or thing in sight; a resident the observer knows by name is taken for another resident the observer also knows.

WORDING. A distorted percept is made of the same tier templates as a true one, so it carries the same confidence: no hedge word is added.

DETERMINISM. Each draw is a function of the world seed, the turn, the resident, the subject and a fixed label (domains/impairment.py). It uses no global random state.

NOT MODELLED. Fear and rage are not sources: the world has no fear or rage state (body mood is the only emotion number). Mishearing of speech is not in this table. Shifted quantities (a price read a band too low) are not a percept kind here.

APPROX. Every rate, step threshold, and max_rate is APPROX and authored: a plausible strength for a drunk, a tired, an ill or a dimly lit resident, not measured. The intoxication bands are the world's own (INTOXICATION.bands), and the fatigue, illness and light values are read from the world, not authored.

STAGE NEIGHBOURS. IMPAIRMENT_NEIGHBOURS lists, for each life stage (the keys of PERCEPTION.stage_nouns), the stages a person is most easily taken for. Authored.
